# This is the authoritative answer to "what does this site do" for the sites it
# covers, published by the state's own network operator. It is why the registry
# needs no scraping to name ~250 hosts: the government already published the
# mapping and we read it once.
# Lines beginning # are comments. Blank lines ignored.
# Transcribed verbatim, including the entries whose URLs point off .gov.in
# (gvc.org.in, gujarattourism.com, ssagujarat.org and so on) and the two typos
# the source itself carries ("Government ing and Stationery", "Revenue Tribuna").
# Fixing a quote is how a quote stops being evidence.
